summary: The SEC Form 6-K filed September 24, 2026, details two press releases from Hafnia Limited. The first announces a temporary trading suspension of its ordinary shares on Euronext Oslo Børs until approximately 13:00 CEST that day. The second announces a contemplated offering of ordinary shares. This type of filing, related to a routine shelf takedown or capital raise, is not considered a special situation under the provided criteria.
